scope:
Freeze actual Swiss CPU-WRF forecast profiles for cuplus caller oracles.

This is input assembly, not a captured physics savepoint or a forecast parity
claim. P_HYD and the independent total-pressure PI are retained. Density is
reconstructed with the original hypsometric-2 phy_prep equation. Missing KPBL
and ZOL history diagnostics are explicit caller controls in the manifest.

declared_assembly.PI: independent total pressure (P+PB)/1e5 to WRF REAL R/CP
declared_assembly.RHO: original hypsometric-2 ALT reconstruction from PH/PHB, C3/C4, MU/MUB
declared_assembly.KPBL: explicit caller control from mass heights below stored PBLH; not a captured PBL index
declared_assembly.ZOL: explicit controlled -0.1; unavailable in original history
declared_assembly.W0AVG: fresh-cloud zero running-mean carry; original CPS performs its W update
declared_assembly.P8W: original phy_prep hydrostatic top-down REAL recurrence, C1H/C2H/DNW and all six stored moisture species
declared_assembly.TKE: half stored QKE from original MYNN forecast; input-profile control, not a CAM-UW or MYJ savepoint
declared_assembly.DT: 18s original Swiss namelist; DX from original global attribute
declared_assembly.sampling: two separated interior land columns with largest HFX per hour; no output parity claim
